searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he generation 5 — gevurah critique the awtsmoos gives every expanding light a vessel fit to hold; awtsmoos.com must improve without invented facts, unsafe writes, or architecture grown cold. critique and selection do not implement fake hreflang because current translations do not expose trustworthy paired standalone language identities. do not fabricate publication dates, ratings, prices, platforms, or translation titles. do not add hidden h1 text merely to satisfy an audit metric. do not broaden profilepage data beyond already public alias fields. do not index auth/api/action/admin/edit/control routes. do not weaken crawler failure semantics to hide redirects, 404s, or server errors. do not recursively crawl without hard concurrency, url, sitemap, and timeout limits. do not transplant remote overlap files when the tested change did not require them. do not force the dirty canonical checkout onto latest remote while unrelated agents own overlapping dirty files. do not edit generated artifacts or release manifests by hand. prefer fixes that remove real discovery ambiguity and improve users and crawlers simultaneously. highest value immediate work 1. finish /heichelos/ semantic head at its local renderer boundary. 2. add renderer regression covering canonical, robots, title, description, and collectionpage json ld. 3. restart a fresh process and rerun targeted + full crawl. 4. improve crawler report with latency percentiles only if the full graph remains stable and this does not delay deployment. 5. transplant exact tested seo files to the clean current origin worktree. 6. verify byte identity and generated artifact determinism. 7. run all focused, heichel, route, and tunnel release gates in clean worktree. 8. fresh worktree runtime proof. 9. race check origin/main; rebase/recreate only if required. 10. commit, push, exact sha activate, raw public verify, browser shadow verify.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he generation 6 — gevurah release risk map the awtsmoos gives expanding light a vessel whose border keeps truth whole; awtsmoos.com must not trade a fast release for a broken corpus, stale branch, or uncontrolled role. critical risks 1. replaying an already accepted corpus mirror and corrupting custody. 2. treating intentionally ignored runtime data as git owned source. 3. letting the clean worktree miss runtime corpus needed by real integrity tests. 4. staging ignored corpus files or unrelated concurrent agent files. 5. overwriting newer upstream htmlcompactmodules.js or other remote owned changes. 6. trusting source checkout tests instead of clean latest origin integration tests. 7. pushing after origin/main moves. 8. deploying a sha not equal to pushed remote main. 9. confusing local server success with production activation. 10. confusing cached search/crawler views with current origin behavior. 11. weakening crawl verification to make a release pass. 12. fabricating seo metadata absent from source data. 13. adding speculative features after the release candidate is already proven, increasing blast radius. 14. declaring completion before public raw https and browser shadow evidence exist. 15. leaving durable remaining work stale after success or failure. restraint law finish the current candidate first. any new architecture discovered now must enter future evolution memory unless it closes a concrete defect observed by tests, runtime, integration, or production.
